scope: Static routing audit with explicitly scoped live evidence for OpenTab and tab metadata. Entry presence is not availability; observed fields are not full schemas. No live DOM primitive claim.

namedEntries.name: FindSelectors
namedEntries.note: Routes content command 8 to FindSelectors_OriginalRequest/CrossOriginRequest; partialRequests schema and customId cache lifecycle need live verification.

namedEntries.name: FindWebCtrlElements
namedEntries.note: Only local declarations; no callback or content dispatch.

namedEntries.name: GetHtmlAttribute
namedEntries.liveVerifiedScope: Tab metadata only: empty customId with url/title/readystate

namedEntries.name: GetHtmlElemById
namedEntries.note: Valid index with tabId=-1 resolves a browser tab. No DOM reply for ordinary tabId.

sourceContract.verifiedBy: Independent pinned installed source inspection; no live claim

namedEntries.name: InjectAndRunJs
namedEntries.note: Accepts jsCode/input/executionWorld; may inject through debugger. Runtime unverified.

namedEntries.name: NavigationCommand
namedEntries.note: activate can focus window via activateWindow; home hardcodes http://www.google.com. Only activate/home/reload routing audited, not runtime.

namedEntries.name: OpenTab
namedEntries.liveVerifiedScope: HTTP local fixture new tab only

namedEntries.name: RunJS
namedEntries.note: scriptName resolves g_globalContext.CallableScripts; does not accept arbitrary jsCode.

namedEntries.name: TakeScreenshot
namedEntries.note: VIEWPORT/ELEMENT/BOUNDS use captureVisibleTab(windowId). FULLPAGE uses debugger. Requires active-tab identity checks and transport design.

namedEntries.name: WriteTextHtmlElem
namedEntries.note: Non-debugger path reaches Content.WriteText; debugger path is separate and uses key tokens/options. No live DOM typing claim.

publicationNote: Historical evidence; absolute machine paths sanitized for publication. Not a fresh verification on the reader machine.
